criteria.adjusted_auroc: adjusted-arm mean held-out CV stage AUROC at the anchor inside auroc_band
criteria.unadjusted_rejects: unadjusted-arm anchor rejection rate (p <= alpha) above alpha on at least one statistic
criteria.unadjusted_rho: unadjusted-arm median |Spearman| of the first latent component with z at the anchor >= rho_threshold

categorical.role: drawn (the D10 RNG stream is kept); neither declared nor injected

injection.scale: pooled feature SD on the analysed scale

rule.controls: anchor and translation, every statistic, rate <= alpha + k*sqrt(alpha(1-alpha)/R)
rule.decision: primary_validated when adjusted holds every control statistic; else adopt_latent_stage when latent_stage does; else diagnose_configuration_excess
rule.rate: share of available replicates with p <= alpha
rule.unadjusted: descriptive (evidence the construction confounds); never judged
